Thanks — reviewed. High-level summary of proposed redlines attached (MSA_redlines_20261108.pdf).

What I did:
- Consolidated exhibits: added a single Exhibit A (Order Form) and a sequencing clause stating Exhibit A governs if there's any conflict.
- Term & renewal: accepted 18-month fixed term with one optional 12-month renewal; added explicit notice windows.
- SLA: proposed a two-tier credit (per-incident latency SLA and availability SLA) capped at 20% of monthly fees.
- Data/Compliance: agreed to provide SOC2 Type II report annually; refused on-the-fly audit access but offered audit log extracts on request with 30 days notice.
- Liability: kept existing MSA liability caps intact (no increase).

Open questions for Sales/Product:
1) The customer requests sustained throughput guarantees — is that qps or token-based? Jordan, need your confirmation so I can draft the measurable metric.
2) Pricing rollback: the customer asked for protection if list pricing drops — we should not grant retro active price matching; propose forward-looking price protection for the 18-month term only.

If Sales is comfortable, I will circulate tracked changes to Cara for review tonight.
